$comment: Nine invented cases for the demo, from the invented bank Meridian Trust Bank: three applications from individuals (ONB-1001 to ONB-1003), three from companies (ONB-1004 to ONB-1006) and three periodic reviews (KYR-1001 to KYR-1003). The customers, applicants, companies and documents do not exist. Dates are as at the bank date 2026-11-24. Each case names only what the bank's onboarding system holds.

cases.title: Odalys Merrowby (ONB-1001)
cases.text:
APPLICATION
Application: ONB-1001
Kind: Individual
Product: Everyday Current Account
Received: 21 Nov 2026
Channel: branch

ON THE FORM
Full name: Odalys Merrowby
Date of birth: 18 Apr 1990
Nationality: Meridia
Address: 14 Wren Alley, Port Ilvane, Meridia
Identity number: ending 2045
Occupation: Dental nurse
Employer: Stillwater Clinic
Source of funds: Salary
Expected credits: USD 3,200 a month

DOCUMENTS RECEIVED
OND-1001-01: identity document, National identity card (extract)
OND-1001-02: Proof of address (extract)

WHAT THE BANK REQUIRES
Documents: an identity document that is valid, and a proof of address dated within the last 3 months (90 days).
Checks: every field of the form against the identity document and the proof of address, and the applicant's name, date of birth and nationality against the bank's watchlist.
A strong watchlist match is never opened by the branch. It is referred to Compliance.

Everything here is as the onboarding system holds it. The agent reads the documents themselves from that system.

Country: Meridia

Directors: Bertrand Ulverstone
Owners declared: Bertrand Ulverstone, person, Meridia, 100 percent
Signatory: Bertrand Ulverstone
Expected turnover: USD 480,000 a year

DOCUMENTS RECEIVED
OND-1004-01: Company registry extract
OND-1004-02: constitutional documents, Articles of association (extract)
OND-1004-03: Ownership declaration

WHAT THE BANK REQUIRES
Documents: a company registry extract issued within the last 3 months, the constitutional documents, and an ownership declaration signed by a director.
Checks: the company, every director on the registry extract and every owner of 25 percent or more are screened. The directors on the registry extract are compared with the directors on the form.
The ownership chain is built down to the people behind it. Every gap is listed. A gap is never filled from memory or guessed.

Everything here is as the onboarding system holds it. The agent reads the documents themselves from that system.

Name: Cassius Dunmore
Date of birth: 4 Sep 1965
Nationality: Meridia
Address: 5 Thistledown Mews, Port Ilvane, Meridia
Identity number: ending 1947
Occupation: Harbour pilot
Employer: Tallowby Council Works
Source of funds: Salary

FRESH DOCUMENTS RECEIVED
KYD-1001-01: identity document, National identity card (extract)
KYD-1001-02: Proof of address (extract)

WHAT THE BANK REQUIRES
A proof of address must be dated within the last 3 months (90 days).
Every owner of 25 percent or more of a business must be identified, and every owner that is a company must be traced to the people behind it.
Kharnovia (QP) is on the bank's higher-risk list. An owner, director or customer there needs enhanced checks and a higher risk rating.
The customer is screened again against the bank's watchlist. A change of risk rating needs the approval of a named person before the review is completed.

Everything here is as the onboarding system holds it. The agent reads the documents themselves from that system.
